title: First Light Under Dead Stone
description: Aten Ra advances through sacred temple approach with shallow river-light lanes and low sandstone cover while the Gate tests whether solar law can hold under pressure. Appearance rule: Solar Dominion of Khepra is the source culture humans later copied as Egyptian solar myth; mission terrain and cosmetics must show Aten hand-rays, Ma’at scale geometry, electrum, royal linen-light, faience turquoise, lapis, obsidian, Nile-black silt glass, Red Land jasper.
lore: This mission treats Solar Dominion of Khepra as the origin behind Egyptian solar myth: battlefield architecture, reward cosmetics, relic props, and hazard silhouettes must use Aten hand-rays, Ma’at scale geometry, electrum, royal linen-light, faience turquoise, lapis, obsidian, Nile-black silt glass, Red Land jasper instead of generic historical or RPG dressing.
terrain: sacred temple approach with shallow river-light lanes and low sandstone cover; source-culture appearance layer: sun-scale courts, pylon shadow lanes, river-light channels, Khepri dawn engines, Ma’at seal platforms, desert storm edges; cosmetic/relic silhouettes: Ma’at was-sceptre blades, electrum wesekh source-plates, Khepri scarab cores, Uraeus counter-edict silhouettes

objectives.primary: Drive your active deity to the marked solar seal before the Hollow closes around it.
optional: Keep your active deity above 40% integrity
Trigger at least two Momentum, Divinity, or terrain reactions

specialRules: Solar Law: Momentum grows when the lone deity holds marked light lanes without retreating.
Hollow Drift: enemies punish exposed deity positioning and reckless routes.
Solo Deityic Scale: one player-controlled deity occupies the tactical focus; enemies, elites, and bosses scale around that single presence.
victoryConditions: Drive your active deity to the marked solar seal before the Hollow closes around it.

stars.one: Primary completed with one deity standing or severe turn pressure
